senses.gloss:
f. (-मा)
The wife of ŚUKRA.

mfn. (-वान्-वुषी^1-वत्^2)
Heard, having heard.
E.
श्रु to hear, aff. क्वसु.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320. note: f. SuSruvuzI per Kale 124. (thanks to SergeA).
[2] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320. note: n. Also per Kale..

m. (-कः)
A servant, comprehending five descriptions of persons, a pupil, a religious pupil or the member of a religious community under a common head, a hired servant, an officer or deputy, and a slave.
E.
श्रु to hear, desid. v., ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-णं)
Service, serving.
E.
श्रु to hear, desiderative form, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-षा)
1 Service, serving of five kinds: see शुश्रूषक.
2 Saying, speaking, telling.
2 Wishing to hear.
E.
श्रु to hear, desiderative form, अच् aff., fem. aff. टाप्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Diligent or attentive in service.
E.
शुश्रूषा, and पर intent on.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Obedient, serving, attending.
E.
श्रु to hear, desid. v., उ aff.

(औ, ऌ) औशुषॢ r. 4th cl. (शुष्यति^1)
To dry.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321.

m. (-षः)
1 Drying.
2 A hole in the ground.
E.
शुष to dry, aff. क.

r. 1st cl. (शूषति)
To bring forth, to propagate.

r. 1st cl. (सूषति)
To bring forth, to bear; also सूष.

r. 1st cl. (सूषति)
To bring forth, to bear; also षूष.

f. (-षिः-षी)
1 A hole, a chasm.
2 Drying.
3 The hollow or groove in the fang of a snake.
E.
शुष to dry, aff. कि.

f. (-षिः)
1 A hole.
2 Drying.
3 A tube or pipe.
E.
स substituted for श; see शुषि.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Perforated, bored, pierced, full of holes or spaces.
n. (-रं)
1 A hole, a vacuity, a chasm.
2 A wind-instrument.
m. (-रः)
1 Fire.
2 A rat.
f. (-रा)
1 A sort of perfume, commonly Nalī.
2 A river in general.
E.
शुष to dry, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Perforated, pierced.
n. (-रं)
1 A hole.
2 A wind instrument.
f. (-रा)
Nali, a perfume.
m. (-रः)
Fire.
E.
स substituted for शः see शुषिर.

m. (-लः)
Air, wind.
E.
शुष to dry, किरच् aff., semivowel changed to ल.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Well-disposed, of good temper or disposition.
f. (-ला)
The wife of YAMA.
E.
सु well, and शील nature.

mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं)
1 Dry, dried.
2 Groundless, causeless.
3 Unproductive, unprofitable.
E.
शुष to dry, aff. क, or Uṇādi aff. कक्.

f. (-ता)
Dryness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शुष्कत्वं.

n. (-सं)
1 Dry flesh.
2 Dried meat.
E.
शुष्क dry, मांस flesh.

mfn. subst. (-लः-ला-ली-लं)
Dry flesh.
adj.
Eating fish and flesh.
E.
शुष to dry, कलच् Uṇādi aff. or शुष्क, and ला to take, aff. क.

n. (-रं)
Groundless enmity.
E.
शुष्क, and वैर enmity.

m. (-णः)
A scar, a cicatrised sore.
E.
शुष्क dry, and व्रण a sore.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Emaciate, withered.
f. (-ङ्गी)
A lizard, a chameleon.
E.
शुष्क dry, अङ्ग the body.

n. (-न्नं)
Rice in the husk.
E.
शुष्क, and अन्न rice.

n. (-र्द्रं)
Dry ginger.
E.
शुष्क dry, and आर्द्र ginger.

m. (-ष्णः)
1 The sun.
2 Fire.
E.
शुष to dry, न Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ष्मः)
1 The sun.
2 Fire.
3 Air, wind.
n. (-ष्मं)
1 Light, lustre.
2 Strength, prowess.
E.
शुष to dry, मन् aff.

n. (-श्मं)
A rope, a cord.

m. (-ष्मा)
Fire.
n. (-ष्म)
1 Light, lustre.
2 Strength, prowess.
E.
शुष to dry, मनिन् aff.

mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्)
Drying.
E.
शुष to dry, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Easily made or done.
E.
सु, and शक able.

mfn. (-म्मा-म्मा-म्म)
Exquisitely happy.
m. (-र्म्मा)
The name of a prince.
E.
सु exceeding, शर्म्मन् pleasure.

f. (-वी)
1 A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.)
2 A sort of spice, (Nigella Indica.)
E.
सु well, शव to go, aff. अच् and ङीष्; also सुषवी, सुसवी, &c.

f. (-वी)
1 A sort of gourd, (Momordica charantia.)
2 Black cumin-seed, generally confounded with Kalonji, (Nigella Indica.)
3 Cumin-seed.
E.
सु well, षु to send or direct, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ङीष्; also सुशवी, &c.

f. (-वी)
A sort of pungent seed, either a black species of cumin-seed or the Nigella Indica: see सुषवी.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well-governed.
E.
सु, and शासित governed.

m. (-खः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
सु handsome, and शिखा a crest.

mfn. (-राः-राः-रः)
Having a fine head.
E.
सु, and शिरस् head.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Very cold or cooling.
n. (-तं)
A yellow fragrant sort of Sandal wood.
E.
सु very, शीत cold.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Very cold or cooling, frigid, freezing.
n. (-लं)
A fragrant sort of grass; also कत्तृण.
E.
सु very, शीतल cold.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Cold, frigid.
m. (-मः)
Cold, coldness.
E.
सु much, श्यै to go, aff. मन्, more usually read सुषीम.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Cold, frigid.
2 Pleasant, agreeable.
m. (-मः)
1 Cold.
2 A sort of snake.
3 The moon gem.
E.
सु well, सीमा a limit; also read सुषिम and सुशीम.

f. (-मा)
The mother of the sixth Jaina teacher.

f. (-ता)
Natural amiability, excellence of temper or disposition.
E.
तल् added to the last, also सुशीलत्व n. (-त्वं).

f. (-का)
A sort of yam.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well-heard.
2 Versed in the Vedas.
E.
सु well, श्रुत heard.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Closely united or adhering to.
E.
सु, and श्लिष्ट united.

m. (-षः)
1 Close or intimate union.
2 A close embrace.
E.
सु, and श्लेष embrace.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Beautiful, handsome, pleasing.
2 Same, even, all.
f. (-मा)
1 Exquisite beauty.
2 A period of time peculiar to the Jainas, the second division or Ara of a large period, containing six such portions, and that in which steady happiness is enjoyed by mankind: (the word however more usually occurs written सुखमा, as derived from सुख pleasure.)
E.
मु handsome, सम even, all, and the स changed after this particle.

mfn. (-मा-मा-म)
Sweet or kindly spoken.
E.
सु, and सामन् calming.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Fast asleep.
E.
सु well, ष्वप to sleep, aff. क्त.

f. (-प्तिः)
Deep sleep, profound repose, entire insensibility.
E.
स well, ष्वप to sleep, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Wishing to sleep.
E.
ष्वप, to sleep, desid. v., उ aff.

m. (-णः)
1 A fruit, (Carissa Carondas.)
2 VIṢṆU.
3 The physician of the monkey chief SUGRĪVA.
4 A cane or reed, the ratan.
f. (-णी)
A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
E.
सु excellent, सेना a host or cluster.

f. (-का)
Black Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
E.
कन् added to the last.

ind.
1 Much, very much.
2 Well, excellent.
E.
सु well, स्था to stay, aff. कु.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dressed, seasoned, prepared with condiments, sauces, &c.
2 Entirely perfected, very highly finished, &c.
E.
सु well, संस्कृत made perfect.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well situated or placed.
2 Being or doing well.
3 Circumscribed, well defined.
E.
मु and सम् before स्था to stay, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well compacted or united, well knit.
E.
सु, and संहत collected.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well kept or preserved.
2 Well abridged.
E.
सु, and सङ्गृहीत taken.

f. (-म्पद् or म्पत्)
Fortune, prosperity.
E.
सु good, and सम्पद् prosperity.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Easily borne or suffered.
2 Bearing or enduring well.
E.
सु well, and सह suffering.

m. (-रः)
A sort of Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)
E.
सु good, सार essence.

n. (-वत्)
Crystal.
E.
सु excellent, सार essence, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Assiduously served or attended upon.
2 Much addicted to.
E.
सु, and सेवित served.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Well, healthy.
2 Happy, faring or living well.
E.
सु well, and स्थ being.

f. (-ता)
1 Health.
2 Welfare, happiness.
E.
सुस्थ being well, तल् aff. of condition.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Setting at rest, appeasing, consoling.
E.
सुस्थ being well, used as a verb, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Living well or happily.
2 Being well, in health or condition.
E.
सु, and स्थित who or what stays in.

f. (-तिः)
1 Well being, welfare.
2 Health, convalescence.
E.
सु, and स्थिति staying.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Firm, steady, stable.
2 Resolute, cool.
E.
सु well, and स्थिर steady.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Wishing or trying to recollect.
E.
स्मृ to remember, desid. v., शानच् aff.

n. (-प्नं)
A lucky or good dream.
E.
सु, and स्वप्न a dream.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well bathed.
m. (-तः)
A student, who has performed his ablutions preparatory or subsequent to a sacrifice.
E.
सु auspiciously, स्नात bathed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Smiling.
f. (-ता)
A woman with a pleasing or smiling countenance.
E.
मु well, pleasant, and स्मित smiling.
